act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

section.heading: Reasonable time for transmitting such notice
section.html: A party receiving notice of dishonour, who seeks to enforce his right against a prior party, transmits the notice within a reasonable time if he transmits it within the same time after its receipt as he would have had to give notice if he had been the holder.
section.text: A party receiving notice of dishonour, who seeks to enforce his right against a prior party, transmits the notice within a reasonable time if he transmits it within the same time after its receipt as he would have had to give notice if he had been the holder.
